annotation.bound_parties_text: The model regulations address registration, inspection and approval of unmanned aircraft, operators and remote pilots, manufacturers under Part 102, and Approved Aviation Organizations and Civil Aviation Authorities; as a model text it binds States only if adopted.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: Part 149: promotes using Approved Aviation Organizations as designees for tasks such as remote pilot licensing and UA inspection or approval
annotation.dates_quote: Living document (Parts 101 and 102 version valid 5 April 2023; ACs valid November 2021)
annotation.robot_provision_quote: ICAO reviewed national UAS rules and produced the Model UAS Regulations as Parts 101, 102 and 149.
